analysis_input_water_diagnostic.density_source_formula: module_initialize_real.F:3926-3928 stores ALT=AL+ALB as inverse dry density; diagnostic uses REAL4(1.0/REAL4(AL+ALB))
analysis_input_water_diagnostic.layer_thickness_source: READY40 DELZ reconstructed from retained PH_2/PHB using the verified big_step_utilities_em.F z_at_w and dz8w expression; this is a READY snapshot reconstruction, not a captured per-call DELZ
analysis_input_water_diagnostic.layer_thickness_source_formula: module_big_step_utilities_em.F computes Z_AT_W=(PHB+PH_2)/g then DZ8W=Z_AT_W(k+1)-Z_AT_W(k); reproduced each REAL4 operation at the READY boundary
analysis_input_water_diagnostic.rho_dry_source: REAL4(1 / REAL4(AL + ALB)) in recorded operation order, using READY40 AL/ALB; source contract is WRF inverse total dry density
analysis_input_water_diagnostic.scope: READY40 analysis-input-only diagnostic; uses f32-inverted dry density, f32 DELZ reconstructed exactly from captured PH_2/PHB, and native AREA2D; not a closed forecast water budget

THM_2.description: either 1) pert moist pot temp=(1+Rv/Rd Qv)*(theta)-T0, or 2) pert dry pot temp=t

forward_pair.scope: full serialized restart comparison; candidate and control share an exact READY boundary, so this is the output response to the one analysis update under this run pair

host_derivative_limit: No full-host adjoint; not a gradient or optimizer acceptance certificate.

producer.scope: offline post-run comparison/diagnostic producer; no model calls

temperature_representation: The reported WRF variables T and THM_2 are perturbation potential-temperature coordinates per their NetCDF descriptions; this artifact does not reconstruct physical temperature.
